name: Rustic Home
old_description: If we don't have what you're looking for in our shop... we'll have it made and customized just for you!
about:
Rustic Home operates a retail showroom in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The business is owned by Norma, who runs the store with a partner referred to as Daisy. The founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The store specializes in rustic-style home furnishings, including furniture pieces that are handmade in Mexico to order. Each item features intentional distressing, cracks, and color variations that give it a unique character. Beyond furniture, the shop carries throw blankets, pillows, incense, and other Southwestern decor accents. Custom orders are accepted for pieces not in stock.

Rustic Home serves individual consumers and interior designers seeking rustic and Southwestern aesthetic pieces for residential spaces. Customers visit the physical store at 9304 4th St NW for in-person selection, though the business also facilitates made-to-order arrangements through its Mexican workshop partners.

The company emphasizes the one-of-a-kind nature of its handmade goods, noting that no two pieces match exactly but coordinate well together. This variability, along with personalized service and a frequently updated inventory, is presented as the core appeal.
